group.label: Voice Input
group.comment: Speak to the assistant instead of typing. Speech is converted to text by the browser's own speech recognition, so the audio is handled by the browser vendor (for example Google for Chrome), never by Mago or the AI provider. The resulting text is treated exactly like typed text.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Show a microphone button in the chat panel. Speech is turned into text by the browser's own speech recognition, so the audio is handled by the browser vendor (e.g. Google for Chrome), not by Mago or the AI provider. The recognised text is editable and treated exactly like typed text. Only shown in browsers that support speech recognition.

field.label: Language
field.comment: The language the browser listens for. Speaking another language than the one selected here gives garbled text, so pick the language administrators actually speak rather than the interface language.

field.label: Voice Mode
field.comment:
Dictate: press the microphone, speak, check the text and press Send yourself.
Send after a pause: press the microphone once. The message is sent on its own after a short countdown once you stop talking; after the answer the microphone listens again for your next message.
Conversation: press the microphone once. After each pause a Send / Discard / Continue bar appears; say "send", "discard" or "continue" (to add more), or click it. While the assistant answers the microphone is paused, then it listens again for your next message. Press the microphone or start typing to stop.

field.label: Send Delay (ms)
field.comment: Send after a pause only: how long to wait after speech stops before the message is sent, in milliseconds (default 1400). The browser itself already needs a moment of silence to finish a sentence, so values below 500 rarely make a difference. A countdown is shown while waiting.

field.label: Send Words
field.comment: Conversation mode: words that send the message while the "Send this message?" bar is up. Comma-separated words in your own language (the one set under Language above), added to the built-in English words, which always keep working. The first word you enter is the one the panel suggests.

field.label: Discard Words
field.comment: Conversation mode: words that throw the message away and start over. Comma-separated, added to the built-in English words.

field.label: Continue Words
field.comment: Conversation mode: words that close the bar and go back to dictating more of the same message. Comma-separated, added to the built-in English words.

field.label: Allow Words
field.comment: Words that press Allow on a confirmation card, spoken or typed as a short reply. A card that cannot be undone still needs its box ticked by hand first. Comma-separated, added to the built-in English words.

field.label: Reject Words
field.comment: Words that press Reject on a confirmation card, spoken or typed as a short reply. Comma-separated, added to the built-in English words.

field.label: Stop Words
field.comment: Said on their own, these turn the microphone off in any mode, also while a card or the Send bar is waiting. There is deliberately no spoken "start". Comma-separated, added to the built-in English words.
